title: CJ Olive Young says outside access to its internal business systems exposed personal data of 639 employees, 106 partner staff and 45 customers; Money Today reports more records left
date_note: Hankook Ilbo says Olive Young disclosed the incident on 26 November, the page's own day; the page says the access happened on the 23rd.
geo_basis: The page names no city for the company or the victims; country centre of South Korea
summary: CJ Olive Young said on 26 November that unauthorized outside access to its internal business systems occurred on the 23rd and some customer personal data was leaked. It says the leaked data covers 639 employees, 106 partner-company staff and 45 general customers. Money Today reports further member-number and IP records also left, and that the breached system was outside the ISMS-P certification scope. Payment information and passwords were not leaked, the company says.
plain: Olive Young says someone outside gained unauthorized access to its internal systems and data of employees, partner staff and customers leaked. Money Today reports further member-number records also left. The company says payment information and passwords were not leaked.
exec: A retailer's internal systems were accessed without authorization; Money Today reports further records left, and the company says payment information and passwords were not leaked.
action: Olive Young urges customers to be cautious of texts, emails or calls impersonating it that ask for more personal information or money, per Hankook Ilbo.

sources.name: Newsis: 올리브영, 해킹 공격에 직원·고객 포함 790명 이름·연락처 등 개인정보 유출
Money Today: 정보 240만건 유출된 올리브영...'인증 밖' 시스템 뚫렸다

evidence.quote: 임직원 639명, 협력사 관계자 106명, 일반 고객 45명 등 약 790명의 정보가 유출된 것으로 확인된다.
CJ올리브영은 23일 회사 업무 시스템에 대한 외부 비인가 접근이 발생해 고객 개인정보 일부가 유출됐다고 26일 밝혔다.
이와 동시에 회원번호 234만4549건과 회원번호·접속 IP 주소가 함께 담긴 데이터 6만1789건 등 240만6338건도 외부로 빠져나갔다.

validation.note: Hankook Ilbo and Newsis (independent publishers) each state the 26 November Olive Young notice and the 639 employees, 106 partner-company staff and 45 customers; Olive Young's own notice was not read. Money Today (28 Nov, third publisher) adds the 2,406,338 records figure, which it attributes to the company's 26 November notice; the notice itself was not read.

review.note: action advice: sources give Olive Young impersonation warning; replaced No action needed. Figures, dates, payment and passwords checked
